title: Rename the bid_ files in Download by date, oldest first

source.changes: The source's goal is Chinese; the instruction is our English translation, with "numbered from 1" added (the source's check wants 1 to 4 but its goal doesn't say). The fifteen files and their text are the source's. The source dated files relative to the day of the run; ours are fixed dates in March 2026, and which bid file is oldest is a param: the source's order (proposal, catering, design, supplier) is one pick, two other orders are the others. The source deleted every bid_ file in Download first; here setup moves the phone's own bid_ files and same-named files aside and teardown puts them back. Setup also asks the media scanner to re-read each file so file managers show the set dates. The checks are the source's (old names gone, exactly bid_1 to bid_4 with the right extensions, dates ascending), plus one the source didn't have: the eleven other files are still there.

setup.why: Move the phone's own bid_ files and same-named files aside, then write the four bid_ files and eleven others into Download with fixed dates, the bid files' order from the pick.
Open the system file manager (DocumentsUI) on Download.

instruction: In Download, rename the files whose names begin with bid_ in order of their creation date, earliest to latest, all in the form bid_{number}.{original extension}, numbered from 1.

checks.why: The bid_ files in Download are exactly {{o.want}} (so no old name is left, no extension changed and no other file took a bid_ name), and bid_1 to bid_4 are dated in rising order, so each number went to the right file: renaming keeps a file's date. After setup the old names are there, so an agent that does nothing fails.
The eleven other files setup wrote are all still in Download under their own names.
argv: cd /sdcard/Download && ls -1 ai_research_paper.pdf machine_learning_notes.txt data_analysis_report.doc chatbot_training_data.txt computer_vision_project.pdf nlp_processing_guide.doc ai_ethics_discussion.txt deep_learning_tutorial.pdf ai_deployment_strategy.doc recommendation_system.txt ai_performance_metrics.pdf 2>/dev/null | wc -l

teardown.why: Delete the run's files and put back the phone's own files that setup moved aside.

oracle.why: Rename each bid file to its number by date; a rename keeps the file's date.

argv: cd /sdcard/Download && mv bid_restaurant_proposal.txt bid_{{o.pn}}.txt && mv bid_catering_menu_2024.doc bid_{{o.cn}}.doc && mv bid_menu_design_contract.pdf bid_{{o.dn}}.pdf && mv bid_food_supplier_quote.txt bid_{{o.sn}}.txt
